Financial Hardship Evaluation Loan Application

Date: March 15, 2023

Loan Applicant Information:

Full Legal Name: Julie Guy Hoareau
Date of Birth: 09/09/2012
Street Address: 36401 Elizabeth Ports, Suite 627

Loan Information:

Loan Amount Requested: $15,000
Purpose of Loan: To cover unexpected medical bills and living expenses due to temporary unemployment

Employment Information:

Employer Name: Tech Innovations Inc.
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer
Supervisor Name: John Doe
Supervisor Contact Information: (555) 123-4567, [johndoe@techinnovations.com](mailto:johndoe@techinnovations.com)
Date Hired: 01/01/2020
Monthly Income: $7,500 (before taxes)

Financial Hardship Details:

Description of Financial Hardship:
The applicant, Julie Guy Hoareau, has recently experienced a financial hardship due to an unexpected job loss. She was laid off from her position as a Senior Software Engineer at Tech Innovations Inc. on February 15, 2023. As a result, Ms. Hoareau has been unable to meet her financial obligations, including rent, utility bills, and medical expenses.

Medical Expenses:
Ms. Hoareau has incurred significant medical bills due to a recent surgery, amounting to $12,000. She has already paid $2,000 towards these bills and needs the loan to cover the remaining balance.

Temporary Unemployment:
Ms. Hoareau has been actively seeking new employment opportunities and is confident in her ability to secure a new position soon. She has been receiving unemployment benefits of $2,000 per month, but these benefits are not sufficient to cover her living expenses and medical bills.

Supporting Documents:

1. Medical bills (total amount: $12,000)
2. Unemployment benefits statement
